preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The dimensions of the grid H and W must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of particles N must be between 1 and 200.

preconditions.expression: all(-1000 <= h[i][j] <= 1000 for i in range(H) for j in range(W))
preconditions.description: Each cell value h[i][j] must be between -1000 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= y[i] <= H and 1 <= x[i] <= W for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each particle's position (y[i], x[i]) must be within the grid boundaries.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= abs(p[i]) <= 100 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each particle's absolute value |p[i]| must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: len(set((y[i], x[i]) for i in range(N))) == N
preconditions.description: No two particles can occupy the same cell.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the maximum value V followed by the signs of the particles.

postconditions.expression: max_V == sum(p[i] * h[y[i]-1][x[i]-1] for i in range(N)) + sum(p[i] * p[j] for i in range(N) for j in range(i+1, N) if abs(y[i] - y[j]) + abs(x[i] - x[j]) == 1)
postconditions.description: The calculated maximum value V must match the expected value based on the grid and particle positions.

postconditions.expression: all(signs[i] in [-1, 1] for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: Each sign in the output must be either 1 or -1.
